business_summary: Suzhou Etron Technologies Co.,Ltd. provides electronics manufacturing services solutions in China and internationally. the company provides PCBA and box-builds, such as SMT assembly, through-hole, box-build, testing, and protection services; engineering services, including DFM analysis, DFT review, VAVE, and BOM optimization services; NPI prototyping services; production transfer; and supply chain services. It also offers original design manufacturing, including precision motor control solutions, human-machine interface design and manufacturing, battery management system development, connected device solutions, and power electronics and precision motion. In addition, The company offers communication, consumer electronics, medical electronics, automotive electronics products. Further, It provides integrated solutions for manufacturing and testing, supply chain management, customized research and development, and engineering technical support. It serves industrial control and automation, artificial intelligence, AI infrastructure and telecom, healthcare and life sciences, automotive and transportation, energy and storage solution industries. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
